The Hosts panel with Details on and one host failing to connect: its phase, attempt and SSH error

The Trash button over three archived checkouts: the open-lid can and its count
The Trash button while a host frees space, under reduced motion: the can upside down and still, with its count

The Trash dialog over the reference trash asking before build-box's Delete all on: the question in its red band inside build-box's card under its header, naming its one checkout and its size, then Cancel and Delete permanently
The list title's order menu open below it: the shared header, the three orders with Recently active checked and highlighted, and Compact unchecked after a separator

The version readout's red update-menu toggle: with the update arrow, with a withdrawal warning, and with keyboard focus (ring and fill)
The update menu open beside its toggle: Farhelm update, An installed update is ready, Restart to update and What's new
The check button's hover help for a reinstall readout, on the short tooltip cut at eight lines

The same card in a 300-pixel window with a long connection error and run message: the list kept to the running step, each diagnosis cut to its last whole lines, and Full details in Hosts (no reference picture)
